MINUTES
  MALIBU CITY COUNCIL
  SPECIAL MEETING
  OCTOBER 15, 2025
  COUNCIL CHAMBERS
  6:30 P.M.

MEETING CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 6:05 p.m.

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad (via teleconference), Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

PUBLIC COMMENT ON CLOSED SESSION

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Jo Drummond, and Anne K.

RECESS TO CLOSED SESSION

  At 6:08 p.m., the Council recessed to Closed Session to discuss the following items listed
  on the Closed Session agenda:

Conference with Legal Counsel — Existing litigation pursuant to Government Code Section
54956.9(d)(1):

  1.  Case Name: City's Petition to Form Malibu USD from Territory in the Santa
  Monica-Malibu USD

Personnel Matters pursuant to Government Code Section 54957:

  1.  Public Employee Appointment
  Title: City Manager

Conference with Labor Negotiator pursuant to Government Code Section 54957.6:

  1.  City representative: Interim City Attorney Trevor Rusin
  Unrepresented employee: City Manager

REGULAR SESSION CALL TO ORDER

  Mayor Riggins called the meeting to order at 7:26 p.m.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 15, 2025
  Page 2 of 6

ROLL CALL

  The following persons were recorded in attendance by the Recording Secretary:

  PRESENT: Mayor Marianne Riggins; Mayor Pro Tern Bruce Silverstein; and
  Councilmembers Haylynn Conrad, Doug Stewart and Steve Uhring.

  ALSO PRESENT: Trevor Rusin, Interim City Attorney; Candace Bond, Interim City
  Manager; Richard Rojas, Deputy City Manager; Kelsey Pettijohn, City Clerk; Yolanda
  Bundy, Community Development Director; Parker Davis, Media Technician; Christina
  Mutioz, Deputy City Clerk; and Tyler Eaton, Assistant Community Development Director

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

  Mayor Riggins led the Pledge of Allegiance.

CLOSED SESSION REPORT

  Interim City Attorney Rusin reported that the meeting convened at 6:00 p.m., after which
  time the City Council recessed to a Closed Session pursuant to Government Code Sections
  54956.9(d)(1), 54957, and 54957.6, with all Councilmembers present, Councilmember
  Conrad remote. He stated the Council discussed the items on the Closed Session agenda
  and took no reportable action.

REPORT ON POSTING OF AGENDA

  City Clerk Pettijohn reported that the agenda for the meeting was properly posted on
  October 14, 2025.

APPROVAL OF AGENDA

MOTION  Councilmember Uhring moved, and Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein seconded a motion
  to approve the agenda, hearing Item No. 3.B. before Item No. 3.A. The question
  was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

ITEM 1  CONSENT CALENDAR

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment on the Consent Calendar. As
  there were no speaker present, she returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  Councilmember Stewart noted that he would recuse himself from the vote on Item
  No. 1.B.5 because he owned property within 700 feet of the project.

  The Council directed questions to staff regarding Item No. 1.B.6.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 15, 2025
  Page 3 of 6

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein moved, and Mayor Riggins seconded a motion to
  approve the Consent Calendar. The motion carried unanimously, Councilmember
  Stewart recused from Item No. 1.B.5.

  The Consent Calendar consisted of the following items:
  A.  Previously Discussed Items
  None.
  B.  New Items
  1.  Waive Further Reading
  Recommended Action: After the City Attorney has read the title, waive full
  reading of ordinances considered on this agenda for introduction on first
  reading and/or second reading and adoption.
  2.  Approve Warrants
  Recommended Action: Allow and approve warrant demand numbers
  76726-76933 on the register from the General Fund and direct the City
  Manager to pay out the funds to each of the claimants listed in Warrant
  Register No. 776 in the amount of the warrant appearing opposite their
  names, for the purposes stated on the respective demands in a total amount
  of $7,577,644.12. City of Malibu payroll check number 5523-5524 and
  ACH deposits were issued in the amount of $736,911.53
  3.  Approval of Minutes
  Recommended Action: Approve the minutes for the April 28, 2025 Regular
  Meeting and April 30, 2025 Special Meeting.
  4.  Rejection of Bids for the Legacy Park Arbors Renovations Project
  Recommended Action: 1) Reject all bids received for the Legacy Parks
  Arbors Renovations Project, Specification No. 2114; and 2) Direct staff to
  reduce scope of work required to renovate the arbors at Legacy Park and
  rebid the project.
  5.  Latigo Canyon Road Retaining Walls Project
  Recommended Action: 1) Approve the award and authorize the Mayor to
  execute a construction contract with Taylor Jane Construction LP, in the
  amount of $1,421,780 for the construction of the Latigo Canyon Road
  Retaining Walls Rehabilitation Project Specification No. 2087; and 2)
  Authorize the Public Works Director to approve any potential change orders
  up to 20% of the contract amount.
  6.  Commercial Property Fire Debris Abatement — Authorization to Issue
  Public Bid
  Recommended Action: Authorize staff to issue a public bid for fire debris
  abatement services for commercial and multifamily properties.

ITEM 2  CEREMONIAL/PRESENTATIONS

  A.  Update on Fire Rebuild Process Streamlining

  Community Development Director Bundy presented an update on fire rebuild
  permit processing and new process improvements.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 15, 2025
  Page 4 of 6

ITEM 3  OLD BUSINESS

  B.  Rebuild Policies to Facilitate the Rebuilding of Structures Damaged or Destroyed
  by Natural Disasters
  Recommended Action: Approve Rebuild Policies - Local Coastal Program (LCP)
  Interpretation Number 24 and Zoning Code Interpretation Number 15 — Issue No.
  10.

  Assistant Planning Director Eaton presented the staff report.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Arno Koch (Gretchen Smith, Jim Rogers, and Jo Drummond deferred
  time to Arno Koch), Kevin Keegan, Danny Smith, and Darren Graves

  Arnold Bernstein was not present at the time of the hearing.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring second a motion
  to approve Rebuild Policies - Local Coastal Program (LCP) Interpretation Number
  24 and Zoning Code Interpretation Number 15 — Issue No. 10, amending the last
  paragraph to state "For all replacement beachfront structures, the structure's height
  above sea level shall be determined by the Federal Emergency Management
  Agency's (FEMA) flood plain regulations as stated in MMC section
  17.60.020(C)(1) with no additional sea level rise requirements imposed by the City.
  Onsite wastewater treatment systems and seawalls that are being built along with
  the replacement beachfront structure will be required to be designed by the
  applicant's coastal engineer with no additional sea level rise requirements imposed
  by the City. The design must be provided in either a (i) coastal engineering or wave
  uprush report, or (ii) letter certified and stamped by the applicant's coastal engineer,
  who must be a California licensed civil engineer experienced in the practice of
  coastal engineering."

  The question was called and the motion carried 4-1, Councilmember Conrad
  opposed.

  A.  Fiscal Year 2025-26 Deferred General Fund Grants
  Recommended Action: Review recommendation by the Administration and
  Finance Subcommittee concerning deferred applications of the General Fund Grant
  Program and provide direction regarding the deferred grant requests.

  Councilmember Stewart and Councilmember Conrad noted that they would recuse
  themselves from the Friends of Malibu Urgent Care item.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 15, 2025
  Page 5 of 6

  The Council determined it would consider the grant requests individually.

  Deputy City Manager Rojas presented the staff report on the requests from Malibu
  Education Foundation, LAEPF — Community Brigade, and Mission Nirvana
  Malibu.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment.

  Speakers: Kevin Keegan and Karin Al Hardaan.

  The Council directed questions to Ms. Al Hardaan.

  As there were no other speakers present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the
  table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item.

MOTION  Councilmember Stewart moved, and Mayor Riggins seconded a motion to approve
  a $315,000 grant to the Malibu Education Foundation, to be awarded in two equal
  installments. The question was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

  The Council discussed the item.

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tem Silverstein moved to approve the Administration and Finance
  Subcommittee recommendations for LAEPF — Community Brigade, and Mission
  Nirvana Malibu grant requests, awarding a $100,000 grant to the LAEPF —
  Community Brigade and denying the grant request from Mission Nirvana.

  The Council discussed the item.

  Councilmember Uhring seconded the motion.

  The question was called, and the motion carried unanimously.

  Councilmember Stewart and Councilmember Conrad recused themselves at 9:57
  p.m. Councilmember Stewart left the dais and Councilmember Conrad muted
  herself on the teleconference line.

  Deputy City Manager Rojas presented the staff report on the request from Friends
  of Malibu Urgent Care.

  Mayor Riggins opened the floor to public comment. As there were no speakers
  present, Mayor Riggins returned the matter to the table for discussion.

  The Council discussed the item and directed questions to staff.
   Malibu City Council
  Minutes of October 15, 2025
  Page 6 of 6

MOTION  Mayor Pro Tern Silverstein moved, and Councilmember Uhring seconded a motion
  to deny the grant request for Friends of Malibu Urgent Care.

  The question was called, and the motion carried 3-0, Councilmember Stewart and
  Councilmember Conrad absent.

ADJOURNMENT

  Mayor Riggins adjourned the meeting at 10:06 p.m.

  Approved and adopted by the City Council of the
  City of Malibu on June 8, 2026.

  -  BRUCL S L ERSTEIN, Mayor
